profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
self-taught JavaScript web developer, specializing in React and Node.

GitHub: https://github.com/teevans3

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintaining and developing code for full-stack internal CMS web application in primarily JavaScript (React and Node) and some PHP, which include: identifying and solving bugs and defects; implementing new features and constructing architectural patterns; creating and maintaining friendly UI; writing tests for code; documenting restful APIs; using project management tools (Jira); managing database within Drupal on both frontend and backend; working within a team, having daily standup meetings and abiding by a git flow to allow for multiple developers to work on similar areas of application; and more, all confining within agile methodology

positions.title: Data Entry Clerk
positions.description: Collected and filed (both physically, in a file room, and digitally, in a data management system) confidential documents, such as Passports, Visas, etc., for attorneys; requested documents from foreign national individuals; organized/alphabetized and prepared files/cases for attorneys.

positions.title: Project Archaeologist
positions.description:
(Surveyor) Duties include: surveying soil for culturally significant artifacts in different locations (done by excavating and screening/sifting the soil); using a Trimble (GNSS positioning device) to track current location; noting subsurface soil quality and depth; cleaning and analyzing artifacts.

(also worked here from January 2019 - March 2019 - the hiatus is due to this position being project-based)

company.name: Environmental Services, Inc., A Terracon Company

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description: (Customer Service; management) In addition to responsibilities as shift leader, duties included: hiring new employees; help solve employee problems and act as a liaison between other employees and management; assisted my manager in the (weekly) creation of the schedule; solve scheduling issues.

positions.title: Shift Leader
positions.description: (Customer service; management) Responsibilities included; managing/leading a team to serve customers as efficiently as possible; cleaning and preparing the store for the following day; overseeing transactions and counting/depositing register; training new employees.

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description: (Data Entry) Volunteer shift, half day - tracked money from fundraising and organized donations via Raiser's Edge software

company.name: Habitat for Humanity of Wake County

positions.title: Barista/Cashier
positions.description: (Customer service) Responsibilities included: cleaning and stocking workplace as well as customer area; creating drinks for customers; washing dishes.
